name: obsidian-cli
title_zh: 在终端里翻遍整个 Obsidian 库的笔记管家
tagline_zh: 不用切窗口、不用点开 Obsidian，就能按别名、标签或属性捞出那条笔记，顺手改属性、勾任务。
tagline_en: Read, write, search and graph-query a live Obsidian vault straight from your shell — no window switching, no.
desc_en: Drive a running Obsidian vault from the terminal through the official Obsidian CLI — read and write notes, find a note by name, alias, tag or property, query and summarise the whole link graph, search, manage properties, tags and tasks. Use whenever a request needs vault data or a vault operation rather than an explanation of Obsidian's UI. Triggers: Obsidian, obsidian-cli, vault, note, notes, bac
why_zh: 走官方 Obsidian CLI，动的是正在运行的那个库，不是复制一份离线副本，所以改完立刻生效。
why_en: It drives the official Obsidian CLI against your live vault, not a copied snapshot, so every write lands immediately.
limit_zh: Obsidian 必须开着并启用官方 CLI，库没运行就什么都读不到；它只做库内读写与查询，不生成笔记内容。
limit_en: Requires Obsidian running with the official CLI enabled; it only reads/writes/queries vault data, never writes content or touches plugin settings.
title_en: Terminal control for a running Obsidian vault
